Parameters Arquivos, pFormPai, pTipo, pTopo

ThisForm.cntSombra.lblSombra.Caption = ThisForm.Caption
ThisForm.cntSombra.lblTitulo.Caption = ThisForm.Caption

Set DataSession To Arquivos
ThisForm.FormPai = pFormPai
ThisForm.pTipo   = pTipo

ThisForm.Top  = ThisForm.FormPai.Top + ( pTopo - 120 )
ThisForm.Left = ThisForm.FormPai.Left + ( ( ThisForm.FormPai.Width / 2 ) - ( ThisForm.Width / 2 ) )

ThisForm.Get_DtAudits.Value = CrSigCqOch.Datas
ThisForm.get_valor.Value = CrSigMvCcr.Valors
ThisForm.Mem... [TRUNCADO]

Replace ObsAudts With ThisForm.Memo_Obs.Value in CrSigCqOch

If ThisForm.pTipo
	lctipo   = 'Auditado'
	lcUpdate = [Update SigMvCcr Set DtAudits = ?llData, Auditors = ']+Usuar+[ ' Where Grupos = ']+crSigMvCcr.Grupos+[' And Contas = ']+;
				crSigMvCcr.Contas+[' And Moedas = ']+crSigMvCcr.Moedas+[ ' And Nopers = ]+Str(crSigMvCcr.Nopers)
Else
